rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for voluntarily leaving a job, including resigning in protest.

example.english: I decided to resign and stop working at this company.
example.traditional: 我決定辭職，唔再喺呢間公司做。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 ci4 zik1 m4 zoi3 hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when casually saying that you are quitting a job rather than making a formal announcement.

example.english: I've worked so long without a raise, so I'm going to resign.
example.traditional: 做咗咁耐都冇加人工，我唔撈喇。
example.jyutping: zou6 zo2 gam3 noi6 dou1 mou5 gaa1 jan4 gung1 ngo5 m4 lou1 laa3

rows.note: Use this mainly for formally giving up an official, senior, or elected position rather than an ordinary job.

example.english: He announced that he would resign as president.
example.jyutping: keoi5 syun1 bou3 ci4 jam6 wui6 zoeng2 jat1 zik1
